- Changed: [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:110) now supports an experimental local-subcluster radius-band path by ordering vectors within each local subcluster by local-centroid radius and scanning those ranges with the existing radius-prune helper. I also upgraded [measure_official_benchmark_breakdown](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_official_benchmark_breakdown:1) so exact-wrapper ANN runs now emit `ann_stats`, and I recorded the outcome in [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:285), [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:239), [strategy.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/strategy.md:11), and [tools/README.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/README.md:31).

- Current score expectation: the default official cache-first state is still healthy but nowhere near `22000`. `build_project` succeeded, `run_correctness_test` passed at `1.0000` recall, and a fresh official quick `run_benchmark` reached `12697.92 QPS`. I did not run a full official benchmark this cycle, so the honest expectation is still roughly low-`12k` full / low-`13k` quick on the scored path. The experimental ANN branch did not improve the exact gate.

- Next best move: use the new exact ANN stats to test a routing-side change, not another bound on the current local-subcluster layout. The exact A/B at `14 / 136 / 480` showed why: flat baseline was `3763.17 QPS`, while the local-subcluster branch was `3743.44` with local radius pruning off and `3330.85` with it on; exact `ann_stats` showed scan count barely moved (`12126.08 -> 12099.63` vectors/query) while selected subclusters jumped to about `538` and scan time worsened (`269.52 us -> 421.75 us`). The strongest next branch is a better local routing signal or a geometry change that clearly reduces selected ranges before scan.

## Cycle 31

- Added a new fallback ANN scan mode in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1): each vector now records its quantized radius to the cluster centroid, and the non-local-subcluster fallback can keep vectors ordered by that radius and scan only the radius band that can still beat the current prescore heap. The same file also now reports `pruned_vectors` in the ANN stats sink.
- Promoted that radius-band scan into the default ANN fallback behavior by making `VDB_ENABLE_VECTOR_RADIUS_PRUNE` default-on, while keeping it overridable for A/B checks. [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only:1) and [measure_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark:1) now accept explicit `--enable-vector-radius-prune` and `--disable-vector-radius-prune` controls so future cycles can benchmark the branch without ad hoc env wrappers.
- The new branch improved the current ANN fallback baseline in this workspace, but only modestly on the exact gate. With the radius-band mode active, the local preload/search-only harness at the kept `14 / 136 / 480` point improved from about `4698.50 QPS`, `0.9505` recall to about `6297.35`, `0.9506`. On the exact official ANN wrapper, the same point improved from about `4101.72 QPS`, `0.9523` recall with `VDB_ENABLE_VECTOR_RADIUS_PRUNE=0` to about `4294.20`, `0.9522`.
- The important caution is that this is not yet a true pruning breakthrough. ANN stats on the new search-only run still showed about `12219.84` scanned vectors/query and only about `3.57` pruned vectors/query, even though scan time dropped sharply. The evidence says the current win is mostly from a better fallback scan order and a tiny amount of radius-band skipping, not from a materially stronger shortlist.
- Official scored-path validation stayed intact after the fallback change. [run_correctness_test](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_correctness_test:1) still passed at `1.0000` recall, and a fresh quick [run_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_benchmark:1) measured `9991.14 QPS`. That quick score is not a transport improvement and should be treated as workspace noise.
- Next cycle should build on the new per-vector radius metadata instead of stopping at scan-order cleanup. The strongest follow-on ideas are a tighter per-vector or per-subcluster bound that prunes materially more than a few vectors/query, or a routing change that makes a wider shortlist geometry worth retrying on the exact wrapper.
